title: I'm going to ...
summary: **am / is / are going to + глагол** — о намерениях («я решила, что сделаю») и о том, что вот-вот случится по видимым признакам.
ru:
## Две ситуации
**going to** используем для будущего в двух случаях.

## 1. Намерение: я уже решила
**I'm going to do something** = я решила это сделать, это мой план.
> I'm **going to buy** some books tomorrow. — Я собираюсь завтра купить книги.
> Sarah is **going to sell** her car. — Сара собирается продать машину.
> I'm **not going to have** breakfast. I'm not hungry. — Я не буду завтракать: не хочется.
> What are you **going to wear** to the party? — Что ты наденешь на вечеринку?
> Are you **going to invite** John? — Ты собираешься пригласить Джона?
> — Your hands are dirty. — Yes, I know. I'm **going to wash** them. — Руки грязные. — Да, знаю. Сейчас помою.

## 2. Скоро что-то случится (мы это видим)
Когда по текущей ситуации ясно, что событие произойдёт.
> Look at the sky! It's **going to rain**. — Посмотри на небо! Будет дождь.
> It's 9 o'clock and I'm not ready. I'm **going to be** late. — Уже 9, а я не готова. Опоздаю.

## Как образуется
> **am / is / are** + **going to** + глагол (начальная форма)

По-русски: «собираюсь + инфинитив», «буду + инфинитив».

## Сравнение с present continuous
> I'm **playing** tennis with Julia tomorrow. (договорились на время — present continuous)
> I'm **going to play** tennis this week. (намерение, времени пока нет)

Часто оба варианта подходят, особенно для планов.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I going to buy a car.~~ → I **am** going to buy a car. (be нужен)
- ~~She goes to buy a car.~~ → She **is going to** buy a car.
- ~~He is going to buys it.~~ → He is going to **buy** it. (после to — начальная форма)
- ~~Is she going to goes?~~ → Is she going to **go**?
en:
## Two uses
We use **going to** for the future in two situations.

## 1. Intention: I've already decided
**I'm going to do something** = I have decided to do it. It is my plan.
> I'm **going to buy** some books tomorrow.
> Sarah is **going to sell** her car.
> I'm **not going to have** breakfast. I'm not hungry.
> What are you **going to wear** to the party?
> Are you **going to invite** John?
> — Your hands are dirty. — Yes, I know. I'm **going to wash** them.

## 2. Something is going to happen
We also use it when the situation now shows that something will happen.
> Look at the sky! It's **going to rain**.
> It's 9 o'clock and I'm not ready. I'm **going to be** late.

## How to form it
> **am / is / are** + **going to** + infinitive

## Compare with the present continuous
> I'm **playing** tennis with Julia tomorrow. (arranged)
> I'm **going to play** tennis this week. (my intention)

Often both forms are possible.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I going to buy a car.~~ → I **am** going to buy a car.
- ~~He is going to buys it.~~ → He is going to **buy** it.
- ~~Is she going to goes?~~ → Is she going to **go**?
structure:
## Формы
| Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|
| I'm going to eat. | I'm not going to eat. | Am I going to eat? |
| He's going to eat. | He isn't going to eat. | Is he going to eat? |
| We're going to eat. | We aren't going to eat. | Are we going to eat? |

## Краткие формы
- I'm, you're, he's, she's, it's, we're, they're + going to
- isn't, aren't (= is not, are not)

## Краткие ответы
- Are you going to call him? — Yes, I **am**. / No, I'm **not**.
- Is she going to come? — Yes, she **is**. / No, she **isn't**.

## Формула
> подлежащее + **am / is / are** + (not) + **going to** + глагол
> **Wh-слово** + am / is / are + подлежащее + **going to** + глагол ... ?

## Примеры
- What **are** you **going to do**? · Where **is** he **going to stay**?
- It's **going to rain**. · The baby is **going to cry**.

exercises.title: Что вы собираетесь сделать?
exercises.instruction: Допишите предложения, используя **going to** и глагол в скобках.
exercises.example: My hands are dirty. (wash) → I'm going to wash them.

items.text: I'm hungry. I {{am going to eat|'m going to eat}} this sandwich.
Sue is tired. She {{is going to lie down|'s going to lie down}}.
It's Sharon's birthday. We {{are going to give|'re going to give}} her a present.
I don't want to take the bus. I {{am going to walk|'m going to walk}}.
John is going to London. He {{is going to stay|'s going to stay}} with friends.

exercises.title: Отрицания и вопросы
exercises.instruction: Допишите отрицание или вопрос с **going to**.

items.text: I'm tired. I {{am not|'m not}} going to go out tonight.
{{Are}} you going to buy a new phone?
She {{isn't|is not}} going to come to the party.
What {{are}} they going to do tomorrow?
{{Is}} he going to sell his car?
We {{aren't|are not}} going to wait any longer.

items.q: Look at those black clouds! It ___ rain.
I ___ a new job. I've decided.
It's 9 o'clock and I'm not ready. I ___ late.
